howToPlay: Use your attacks to build up your Rage meter and increase your damage and speed. Deploy your mechanical rats to pressure enemies and gain even more Rage. Manage your health and meter carefully by using your Gadgets to recover or instantly boost your performance.
gears: Equip DAMAGE and SPEED for better combat effectiveness, or use SUPER CHARGE to summon your mechanical rats more frequently.
trait: Ash suits an aggressive player who thrives on managing an enraging combat mechanic to dominate the battlefield.
